name: core-bundle-b4
description: B4 adapter handoff for the existing packaged snapshot and verified request subset. The historical proposal filename is retained. This document is neither a runtime allowlist nor a generator input; artifact inclusion does not certify every request path.

decision.scope: Preserve the 804-bundle product and five Day-1 policies; keep the three selected pools regression-only. No product expansion or new decoder-enrichment port.
decision.next_stage: A1 PolicySource, then A2 ERC-20 portfolio.balance; live integration remains unverified

product_snapshot.generation_scope: Retain the committed 799-bundle baseline and rebuild five pinned UR/Aave originals to identical product bytes and metadata. Not regeneration of all 804 originals.
product_snapshot.trust_rule: Pin the reviewed artifact digest in local configuration; do not adopt a remote artifact's claimed digest. maxDecoderBytes must accommodate the artifact's exact UTF-8 bytes.
product_snapshot.exclusion_note: Index entries, not a count of unique pools or supported requests. No automatic Registry lookup, resolver or runtime bundle installation.

verified_product_raw_paths.name: packaged ERC-20 approve
verified_product_raw_paths.scope: Packaged USDC routing. Broader approve policy and transfer/Fact cases use their existing Core fixtures; they do not certify every installed ERC-20 route.

verified_product_raw_paths.name: Universal Router execute with and without deadline
verified_product_raw_paths.scope: V3 command 0x00 self/other recipient and nested V4 0x10/0x07 primary/alternative ABI. Other chains/opcodes are not certified by these cases.
limits: Pool/slippage/LiveField defaults are not market observations
V4 recipient is tx.from; final TAKE/SETTLE recipient and execution are not verified

verified_product_raw_paths.name: Aave governance arrays
verified_product_raw_paths.scope: Ordered proposals, representatives, destination chains and U256 precision; empty/malformed cases. Day-1 allow is not governance safety certification.

verified_product_raw_paths.name: Aave Umbrella claimRewardsPermit
verified_product_raw_paths.scope: Reward order, restake preference, BatchHelper and caller beneficiary; empty/malformed cases.
limits: User permit validity, actual rewards, restaking availability and execution are not verified

regression_only_pools.scope: Three mainnet Curve NG, Balancer V3 and Uniswap V3 template/context inputs; repeated generation and Native/WASM raw semantics verified separately from the product snapshot.
product_promotion_requirements: Keep live skeleton/default values distinct from observations
Resolve Balancer weighted classification evidence and omitted wethIsEth semantics
Resolve Uniswap sqrtPriceLimitX96 loss and token0 metadata requirements for any policy that needs them
regression_only_pools.owner_and_due: Decoder/Registry work before any pool product inclusion; not an A1/A2 prerequisite

public_request_boundary.transaction: Route through the fixed installed snapshot; preserve known malformed errors and Unknown/partial semantics.
public_request_boundary.typed_signature: Strict standard/erc20/permit@1.0.0 only when its installed routing key matches; no v3 fallback, signature verification or onchain nonce/domain lookup.
public_request_boundary.unsupported_behavior: plan rejects UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST; check returns an explicit unsupported warning, not validation success.
public_request_boundary.legacy_scope_note: The eleven-source/four-USDC DEC selection and Permit2 v3 tests remain regression evidence, not a product allowlist or public Core Permit2 support.

policy_handoff.activation: The selected A2 catalog fixture and observation policies are test-only; Day-1 has no active portfolio.balance requirement. Never append these fixtures to Day-1 automatically.

decoder_data_boundary.build_time: Pinned complete manifests and static source contexts; no runtime source materialization.
decoder_data_boundary.local_derivation: Calldata tokens/path, chain/addresses and existing local derived fields stay in Decoder; do not duplicate them as RPC requirements.
decoder_data_boundary.unverified_live_values: UR/NFPM pool or price defaults, Morpho live skeletons and legacy Permit2 nonce representations are not external observations. Policies relying on these values need separate Decoder/Registry review before activation.
decoder_data_boundary.fact_timing: FactProvider receives only plan.calls after decoding. It cannot supply missing decoder prerequisites.
decoder_data_boundary.handoff_scope: Calldata/recipient/array/U256 semantics already covered by the referenced cases. No new pre-decode external data contract is required for this scope; market valuation, final execution and source-context product expansion remain excluded.

integration_followups.owner: API publisher owner + A1 adapter work
items: locally trusted policy public key and env/profile
fresh signed payload and sequence/expiry behavior

integration_followups.owner: SDK/RPC configuration owner + A2 adapter work
items: allowed eip155 chains and RPC endpoints
block selection and actual block provenance

integration_followups.due: before widening decoder-dependent policies or product routes
items: full Registry expansion and additional typed contracts

remaining_release_scope: Actual HTTP/RPC integration and final external tarball/browser consumption are A/release work, not claimed by B3/B4.
